# apache — 2018 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 176 apache CVEs of 2018 are in `data/cve/vendors/apache/2018.jsonl`.

### CVE-2018-1306
- Assigner: apache | Published: 2018-06-27 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Information Disclosure
- Exploit-DB 45396: Apache Portals Pluto 3.0.0 - Remote Code Execution (webapps/windows, 2018-09-13, verified=0)

The PortletV3AnnotatedDemo Multipart Portlet war file code provided in Apache Pluto version 3.0.0 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information, caused by the failure to restrict path information provided during a file upload. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to obtain configuration data and other sensitive information.

Affected:
- Apache Software Foundation / Apache Pluto: affected 3.0.0

References:
- https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/45396/ [exploit,x_refsource_EXPLOIT-DB]
- http://portals.apache.org/pluto/security.html [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2018-1321
- Assigner: apache | Published: 2018-03-20 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: File read and write, remote code execution
- Exploit-DB 45400: Apache Syncope 2.0.7 - Remote Code Execution (webapps/windows, 2018-09-13, verified=0)

An administrator with report and template entitlements in Apache Syncope 1.2.x before 1.2.11, 2.0.x before 2.0.8, and unsupported releases 1.0.x and 1.1.x which may be also affected, can use XSL Transformations (XSLT) to perform malicious operations, including but not limited to file read, file write, and code execution.

Affected:
- Apache Software Foundation / Apache Syncope: affected Releases prior to 1.2.11, Releases prior to 2.0.8; affected The unsupported Releases 1.0.x, 1.1.x may be also affected.

References:
- http://www.securityfocus.com/bid/103508 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_BID]
- http://syncope.apache.org/security.html#CVE-2018-1321:_Remote_code_execution_by_administrators_with_report_and_template_entitlements [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/45400/ [exploit,x_refsource_EXPLOIT-DB]

### CVE-2018-1322
- Assigner: apache | Published: 2018-03-20 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Information disclosure
- Exploit-DB 45400: Apache Syncope 2.0.7 - Remote Code Execution (webapps/windows, 2018-09-13, verified=0)

An administrator with user search entitlements in Apache Syncope 1.2.x before 1.2.11, 2.0.x before 2.0.8, and unsupported releases 1.0.x and 1.1.x which may be also affected, can recover sensitive security values using the fiql and orderby parameters.

Affected:
- Apache Software Foundation / Apache Syncope: affected Releases prior to 1.2.11, Releases prior to 2.0.8; affected The unsupported Releases 1.0.x, 1.1.x may be also affected.

References:

### CVE-2018-1335
- Assigner: apache | Published: 2018-04-25 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Command Injection
- Exploit-DB 47208: Apache Tika 1.15 - 1.17 - Header Command Injection (Metasploit) (remote/windows, 2019-08-05, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 46540: Apache Tika-server < 1.18 - Command Injection (remote/windows, 2019-03-13, verified=1)

From Apache Tika versions 1.7 to 1.17, clients could send carefully crafted headers to tika-server that could be used to inject commands into the command line of the server running tika-server. This vulnerability only affects those running tika-server on a server that is open to untrusted clients. The mitigation is to upgrade to Tika 1.18.

Affected:
- Apache Software Foundation / Apache Tika: affected 1.7 to 1.17

References:
- https://lists.apache.org/thread.html/b3ed4432380af767effd4c6f27665cc7b2686acccbefeb9f55851dca%40%3Cdev.tika.apache.org%3E [mailing-list,x_refsource_MLIST]
- http://www.securityfocus.com/bid/104001 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_BID]
- https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/46540/ [exploit,x_refsource_EXPLOIT-DB]
- http://packetstormsecurity.com/files/153864/Apache-Tika-1.17-Header-Command-Injection.html [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2018-8021
- Assigner: apache | Published: 2018-11-07 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: RCE
- Exploit-DB 45933: Apache Superset < 0.23 - Remote Code Execution (webapps/linux, 2018-12-03, verified=0)

Versions of Superset prior to 0.23 used an unsafe load method from the pickle library to deserialize data leading to possible remote code execution. Note Superset 0.23 was released prior to any Superset release under the Apache Software Foundation.

- unspecified / Superset: affected prior to 0.23

### CVE-2018-8034
- Assigner: apache | Published: 2018-08-01 | Updated: 2024-10-21 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: Security Constraint Bypass; CWE-295 CWE-295 Improper Certificate Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

The host name verification when using TLS with the WebSocket client was missing. It is now enabled by default. Versions Affected: Apache Tomcat 9.0.0.M1 to 9.0.9, 8.5.0 to 8.5.31, 8.0.0.RC1 to 8.0.52, and 7.0.35 to 7.0.88.

Affected:
- Apache Software Foundation / Apache Tomcat: affected 9.0.0.M1 to 9.0.9; affected 8.5.0 to 8.5.31; affected 8.0.0.RC1 to 8.0.52; affected 7.0.35 to 7.0.88

### CVE-2018-11776
- Assigner: apache | Published: 2018-08-22 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: Remote Code Execution; CWE-noinfo Not enough information
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Unknown — Apache Struts Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 45260: Apache Struts 2.3 < 2.3.34 / 2.5 < 2.5.16 - Remote Code Execution (1) (remote/linux, 2018-08-26, verified=0)
- Exploit-DB 45367: Apache Struts 2 - Namespace Redirect OGNL Injection (Metasploit) (remote/multiple, 2018-09-10, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 45367: Apache Struts 2 - Namespace Redirect OGNL Injection (Metasploit) (remote/multiple, 2018-09-10, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 45262: Apache Struts 2.3 < 2.3.34 / 2.5 < 2.5.16 - Remote Code Execution (2) (remote/multiple, 2018-08-25, verified=0)

Apache Struts versions 2.3 to 2.3.34 and 2.5 to 2.5.16 suffer from possible Remote Code Execution when alwaysSelectFullNamespace is true (either by user or a plugin like Convention Plugin) and then: results are used with no namespace and in same time, its upper package have no or wildcard namespace and similar to results, same possibility when using url tag which doesn't have value and action set and in same time, its upper package have no or wildcard namespace.

Affected:
- Apache Software Foundation / Apache Struts: affected 2.3 to 2.3.34; affected 2.5 to 2.5.16

### CVE-2018-11784
- Assigner: apache | Published: 2018-10-04 | Updated: 2026-10-15 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Open Redirect
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial
- Exploit-DB 50118: Apache Tomcat 9.0.0.M1 - Open Redirect (webapps/multiple, 2021-07-13, verified=0)

When the default servlet in Apache Tomcat versions 9.0.0.M1 to 9.0.11, 8.5.0 to 8.5.33 and 7.0.23 to 7.0.90 returned a redirect to a directory (e.g. redirecting to '/foo/' when the user requested '/foo') a specially crafted URL could be used to cause the redirect to be generated to any URI of the attackers choice.

Affected:
- Apache Software Foundation / Apache Tomcat: affected 9.0.0.M1 to 9.0.11; affected 8.5.0 to 8.5.33; affected 7.0.23 to 7.0.90
